question: In 2021, Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated the X-band Doppler Weather Radar to provide improved forecasts. Where was it inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated the X-band Doppler Weather Radar in **Jammu** in 2021.

• The inauguration was part of the government's effort to provide **improved weather forecasts** for the region.

• The X-band Doppler Weather Radar is crucial for providing **real-time data** on weather conditions, especially in terms of rainfall, wind speed, and storm tracking.

• This radar system is expected to **enhance the accuracy** of weather predictions, thus helping in better disaster management and planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **X-band Doppler Weather Radar**

• The X-band radar operates at a frequency range of 8 to 12 GHz and is particularly effective for short-range weather observations.

• It is capable of providing detailed information about precipitation, including the intensity and movement of rain, snow, and hail.

• Doppler radar technology helps in measuring the velocity of particles within the weather system, which is essential for tracking storms and predicting severe weather events.

• The data from the X-band radar is used by meteorologists to improve weather forecasts, issue timely warnings, and mitigate the impact of natural disasters.

• **Union Minister Jitendra Singh**

• Dr. Jitendra Singh is an Indian politician who serves as the Minister of State for the Ministry of Science and Technology and the Ministry of Earth Sciences, among other portfolios.

• He has been actively involved in promoting scientific research and development in India.

• Under his leadership, various initiatives have been undertaken to improve the country's capabilities in weather forecasting, disaster management, and climate change mitigation.

• **Weather Forecasting**

• Weather forecasting involves predicting the state of the atmosphere at a particular location over a specific period.

• Advanced technologies such as Doppler radar, satellites, and computer models are used to analyze weather patterns and make accurate predictions.

• Accurate weather forecasts are crucial for agriculture, transportation, disaster preparedness, and daily activities.

• Efforts are continuously made to improve the accuracy and reliability of weather forecasts through research and development in meteorology.
